cues.zh: 大家好！你们有没有在报纸或网上读到过一些惊人的巧合，或是极小概率的事件？
cues.en: Hello everyone! Have you ever read in the newspaper on the Internet about some amazing coincidence or unlikely event?

cues.zh: 报道里常会说“这只有百万分之一的几率”，但它偏偏就是发生了。
cues.en: and it will say something like "it was a one in a million chance", but still, it happened.

cues.zh: 其实关键在于，只要机会足够多，再小概率的事件也必然会发生。
cues.en: Well, the point is that even unlikely events will happen if you give them enough opportunities

cues.zh: 比如连续抛出 10 次正面，概率大概是千分之一。
cues.en: For example, flipping 10 heads in a row. Well that's about one in a thousand

cues.zh: 实际上它是二分之一的 10 次方，也就是 1024 分之一。
cues.en: when in fact it's a half to the power of 10, which is 1 in 1024.

cues.zh: 现在，如果你把这个实验做 1024 次，你可能会觉得它能出现一次。
cues.en: Now, if you perform the experiment 1024 times you might expect it to happen once

cues.zh: 其实你可能见过魔术师 Derren Brown 试过这个，他足足花了 9 个小时。
cues.en: In fact you may have seen the magician Derren Brown try this and it took him 9 hours

cues.zh: 那么，他算走运还是倒霉呢？我们来一探究竟，我也要亲自试一下！
cues.en: Now, was he lucky or unlucky? Let's find out, I'm gonna do it!

cues.zh: 这是我的硬币，给大家看一下。这边是女王，这是女王的头像。
cues.en: Here's my coin, I will show you. There's the Queen there. there's the Queen's face

cues.zh: 另一面是反面，我画了个大大的 X，叉号，不行，这就惨了，这就是失败的反面。
cues.en: On the other side there's the tail which I've marked with a big X, cross, no, this is bad, this is the failed tail right there.

cues.zh: 现在我们来试试，这是我的第一次尝试，我要把硬币抛进碗里
cues.en: Now, let's try it out, this is my first attempt, I'm gonna flip the coin into the bowl

cues.zh: *叮当声*
cues.en: *DLING*

cues.zh: 我得到了……反面！开局不利，但好歹完成了一次，还剩1023次。
cues.en: And I get... A tail! Not a good start, but still, that's one down, 1023 to go.

cues.zh: 我正是这么做的：一次又一次，一枚又一枚，不停地抛硬币，
cues.en: And that's exactly what I did: try after try, coin after coin, continuously flipping the coin,

cues.zh: 直到连续抛出10次正面。
cues.en: until I got 10 heads in a row.

cues.zh: 我知道大多数尝试都不会成功。事实上绝大多数，将近90%，都会在第一、第二或第三次尝试就结束
cues.en: I knew most of my attempts would not be succesful. In fact the vast majority, nearly 90%, would end on only the first, second or third trial

cues.zh: 好的一面是，这意味着我一看到反面就能停止这次尝试，从而节省大量时间。
cues.en: On the plus side that meant I could stop the trial as soon as I saw a tail, which meant I could save a lot of time.

cues.zh: 即便如此，像？一样，我完全做好了1024次尝试要花9到10个小时的准备
cues.en: Even so, like ?, I was fully prepared that 1024 attempts would take 9 or 10 hours

cues.zh: 但实际情况还要更糟。如果我做1024次实验，我期望有1次成功，但那只是平均值！
cues.en: Yet it's even worse than that. If I tried the experiment 1024 times, I expect 1 success, but that's an average!

cues.zh: 我可能成功三次，可能成功两次，也可能彻底失败，还可能试了1024次，每次都失败。
cues.en: I might three successes, I might get two, I might fail completely, I might try 1024 times and fail every single time.

cues.zh: 其实我早就知道。如果单次成功概率是1/1024，那失败概率就是1023/1024。
cues.en: In fact I knew that. If the probability of success was 1 in 1024, than the probability of failure is 1023 in 1024

cues.zh: 而每次都失败的概率，就是这个数的1024次方。这正是我打算进行的试验次数。
cues.en: And the probability of failing every time would be that to the power 1024. That's the number of trials I intended to perform.

cues.zh: 也就是说，彻底失败的概率大约是37%。
cues.en: That means the probability of total failure was about 37%.

cues.zh: 那么成功的概率就是63%，但绝不是稳赢。我不断尝试，直到一小时后，在第234次试验时……
cues.en: Success then was 63% but in no way guaranteed. But I kept trying and trying until one hour in and on trial 234...

cues.zh: 正面。
cues.en: Head.

cues.zh: 两个正面。
cues.en: Two heads.

cues.zh: 三个正面。
cues.en: Three heads.

cues.zh: 四个正面。
cues.en: Four heads.

cues.zh: 五个正面。
cues.en: Five heads.

cues.zh: 六个正面。
cues.en: Six heads.

cues.zh: 七个正面。
cues.en: Seven heads.

cues.zh: 八个正面。
cues.en: Eight heads.

cues.zh: 九个正面。
cues.en: Nine heads.

cues.zh: 十个正面。
cues.en: Ten heads.

cues.zh: 连续十个正面！
cues.en: Ten heads in a row!

cues.zh: 成功了，而且比我预想的还早。本来我可以就此打住，但我决定把实验做完，完成这1024次试验。
cues.en: Success and not sooner than I expected. So I could have stopped right there I decided to complete the experiment to finish the 1024 trials.

cues.zh: 但既然我已经成功过一次，那就意味着我现在不会再成功了。
cues.en: But since I had already had 1 success that means I wouldn't get another now.

cues.zh: 我知道这不对，因为硬币没有记忆，过去的成功不会影响未来的成功。
cues.en: Well I knew that wasn't true because a coin has no memory and success in the past would have no effect on success in the future.

cues.zh: 即便如此，我只剩790次试验了，所以我知道从此刻起完全失败的概率大约是46%。
cues.en: Even so I only had 790 trials to go so I knew the probability of total failure from this point on would be about 46%

cues.zh: 也就是说，我仍有超过一半的机会再成功一次。
cues.en: Meaning I still had a better than half chance of another success.

cues.zh: 然而，不幸的是，在接下来的五个小时里，再也没有成功，但这也说明，只要机会足够多，即使是不太可能的事也会发生。
cues.en: Yet, unfortunately for me, in the next five hours, no further look, but it does go to so that even unlikely events happen if given enough opportunites.

cues.zh: 即使你无法准确预测它们发生的地点和时间。
cues.en: Even if you can't predict exactly where and when they happen.
